description: A small village seen from a gentle height, spread across a bright green meadow. A dozen round huts with brown walls and conical thatched roofs stand scattered among the grass. A dark blue river curves along the lower edge of the village, from the right side across to the left. Behind the huts rises a thick band of dark trees, and above it a clear pale cyan sky. In the center of the village a thin plume of grey smoke rises from a cooking fire. The colors are vivid greens, browns and blues, and the mood is calm and pastoral in daylight. Frame 1: the smoke column drifts in one shape above the huts. Frame 2: the smoke shifts and curls slightly differently. Both frames are held for a short similar time, so the loop reads as a gentle drift of smoke over a peaceful village.
title: Hut village by a river
